summary: The PR successfully reorganizes installation scripts from repository root to scripts/bootstrap/, consolidating cross-platform installers with new Windows CMD batch support and updated documentation. All acceptance criteria are met: scripts unified under single directory, platform-specific installers present for Linux/macOS/Windows, README and RUNBOOK updated with new paths, CI workflows maintain compatibility, and no breaking changes introduced. However, the PR includes two coverage report artifacts (coverage.html - 1MB, coverage.out - 394KB) that were accidentally committed as new files. These are generated test outputs from go test runs that should not be part of source control.
reviewedAreas: Bootstrap scripts unified: install.sh, install.ps1 moved to scripts/bootstrap/
Windows CMD batch support added: install.bat wrapper invoking PowerShell with Bypass execution policy
Documentation updated: README.md lines 193,205,611,614 reference new paths; RUNBOOK.md lines 26-31 updated; self-update guidance removed
CI workflow compatibility: .github/workflows/release.yml validation paths updated to scripts/bootstrap/
Installation scripts verified: install.sh handles OS/arch detection and dependency installation; install.ps1 manages Windows runtime with checksum verification
Code quality: All scripts use appropriate error handling, idempotent upgrades, proper cleanup

blockers.impact: Coverage artifacts (coverage.html - 1MB HTML report, coverage.out - 394KB profile) were added as new files to the repository. These are generated test outputs from go test runs and pollute source control with build artifacts.
CMD batch example uses single-line syntax (@echo off && ...) which differs slightly from install.bat structure, though functionally equivalent

fixes: Remove coverage.html and coverage.out from the commit - these test artifacts should be excluded or removed from source control
Consider adding *.html and *.out (except for specific reports) to .git/info/exclude to prevent future accidental commits
validation: git diff HEAD --name-only | grep -v ^\.github/ should show only: README.md, CHANGELOG.md, docs/RUNBOOK.md, scripts/bootstrap/install.bat, and the renamed install.ps1/sh without coverage files
residualRisks: Coverage file removal requires rebasing or amending commit history, which may conflict with existing CI/CD pipeline expectations
additionalNotes: The PR implementation is sound and meets all acceptance criteria. The only issue is the accidental inclusion of test artifacts that should be cleaned up before approval.
